Cue_Trail.channels: road light trail: U along the travel direction (tiles; the head points to +U), V across. R one long soft light streak per tile, G its glow plus a faint continuous guide line, B sparkle motes in the tail. Scroll: uv.x -= time * speed so the pulses run towards the base

Cue_Dash.channels: flight route: four light beads with short tails per tile (heads to +U), faint guide line in G; scroll like Cue_Trail. Replaces the dashes and the arrowheads

Cue_Pulse.channels: pulse ring: R soft ring at r 0.78, G centre dot. Scale the quad 0.4 -> 3 and fade alpha for an expanding pulse (spawn mouths, recon rings, route start)

RoadCue_Strip.note: 1 unit long along Unity +Z (travel), 0.42 wide; U along. One per road cell (Road.CentreOf, LookRotation(forward)), or tile Cue_Trail on a LineRenderer ribbon

FlightCue_Strip.note: 1 unit long along Unity +Z, 0.16 wide; scale Z by the leg length
